Cambodia is causing overseas property buyers to 
delay their purchasing decisions. Risk -averse 
international investors are adopting a "wait -and-see" 
approach, postponing major commitments due to 
geopolitical uncertainties and the need for a stable 
environment to protect their long -term asset value.A Strong Thai Baht

overseas buyers, as their home currencies

lead to delayed purchases and a slowdown in
